usage: 沙嗲牛肉 is a noun and refers to a dish made with beef cooked in satay sauce.
You can use 沙嗲牛肉 as the object in a sentence, for example, '我想食沙嗲牛肉' means 'I want to eat satay beef.'
When ordering food, 沙嗲牛肉 can be used alone or combined with other dishes, like '沙嗲牛肉炒飯' which means 'satay beef fried rice.'
It is commonly used in restaurant menus and food conversations to specify this particular beef dish.
In casual speech, 沙嗲牛肉 can also be shortened to 沙嗲牛.
